name: Live Collab Editor
description: Start a party and build one level together in real time. Everybody in the party is in the same editor: you see each other's objects, selections and changes instantly. No server needed: your own game hosts the party.

server.name: Party server (optional)
server.description: Leave this <cg>empty</c>: when you press Start party your own game hosts the party and nothing has to be set up. Only if somebody runs a party server (server/server.js) type its address here, for example <cy>play.example.com</c> or <cy>play.example.com:5588</c>. Invites by name need a party server.

public-address.name: Public address (advanced)
public-address.description: Only needed when the automatic port opening does not work (the window tells you). Forward TCP port <cy>5588</c> to this PC in your router, or use a tunnel such as playit.gg, and type the address friends can reach you on, for example <cy>12.34.56.78</c> or <cy>name.example.com:25565</c>. Leave it empty for automatic.

player-name.name: Your name
player-name.description: The name the other players see. Leave it empty to use your Geometry Dash account name.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Which corner of the editor the round Collab button sits in. <cy>Hidden</c> removes the button, you can still open the window with the shortcut below.

button-size.name: Button size
button-size.description: How big the round Collab button is.

open-key.name: Open Collab window
open-key.description: Shortcut that opens (and closes) the Collab window while you are in the editor.

copy-code-on-start.name: Copy the party code when starting
copy-code-on-start.description: When you start a party, the code to send to your friends is copied to the clipboard automatically.

show-selections.name: Show other players' selections
show-selections.description: Draw a coloured outline and a name tag around the objects the other players have selected.

join-notifications.name: Join and leave notifications
join-notifications.description: Show a short message when somebody enters or leaves your party.

receive-invites.name: Receive invites
receive-invites.description: While you are in the editor and not in a party, stay connected to the party server so friends can invite you by your name. Only works when a party server is set above.
